title: Fly agaric brownies

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
This is a basic recipe for sweet, chewy and gooey chocolate cake that includes cannabis to simply make classical cannabis brownies.

Ingredients

For 24 brownies.

* Fly agaric
* Roasted hazelnuts 100 g
* Butter 250 g
* Cocoa 2 dl
* Eggs 4
* Powdered sugar 4½ dl
* Salt ½ tsp
* Vanilla powder 1/2 tsp
* Wheat flour 3 dl
* Baking powder ½ tsp

Procedures

* First follow the the ibotenic acid decarboxylation to muscimol tutorial but allow them to be heated 20 minutes less, since they will be mixed and baked with the brownie mix later.
* Set the oven to 175 °C. Place baking paper in a square shape, approx. 20x30 cm.
* Grind the fly agaric. Chop the nuts. Melt the butter and stir in the cocoa.
* Mix eggs and sugar in a bowl. Stir in the cocoa mixture, salt, vanilla powder, nuts and the flour mixed with baking powder
* Spread the batter in the mold. Bake in the middle of the oven for 20 min.
* Let cool and cut the cake into squares. Store in refrigerator.

See also

*Responsible use
*Cannabis
